facts.text: The party must let Squints pick second from the first treasure, after the elite members. That treasure has now been gathered in the Barrow Mound, but Squints has not yet made his pick.

From the Barrow Mound the party holds a jewel-encrusted ceremonial dagger (Dr. Uriah values it at upwards of 200 gold in a major city), seven gold candleholders worth 50 gold each, a skull with gold teeth worth 20 gold and five urns worth 100 gold each.
